provenance.source: production PostgreSQL tables campaign_plans / campaign_nodes / campaign_events
sql: select id, name, status, created_at from campaign_plans where id = 165;

select id, status, dependencies, actual_start, actual_end, planned_start, planned_end, round(extract(epoch from (actual_end - actual_start))::numeric, 3) as duration_s from campaign_nodes where plan_id = 165 order by id;
select event_type, count(*) from campaign_events where plan_id = 165 group by 1;
select event_type, created_at from campaign_events where plan_id = 165 order by created_at;
provenance.anonymisation: node ids replaced by n01..n08 in this fixture; no titles, no domain vocabulary retained

calibration.note: gaps measured between consecutive mission_dispatched events after the initial burst (8 dispatches within 1.5 s); median used as the per-hand-off cost in the serial baseline model

observations: planned_start / planned_end are NULL on all 8 nodes: the baseline ran without a schedule (no critical path, no capacity model)
the summary node declares 7 dependencies but was dispatched at the same instant as its parents (offset 1.5 s) and finished before the longest parent -> declared dependency not enforced
14 dispatch events for 8 nodes -> 1.75 retries/dispatches per node; 2 plan_updated -> 2.0 coordinator-authored events per node
